description: Energize Denver building energy benchmarking master dataset for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/co-denver-energize-benchmarking.md.

sources.publisher: City and County of Denver, Climate Action, Sustainability and Resiliency (via the Denver Open Data Catalog)
sources.license: CC BY 3.0 (the City's GIS page, for the Denver Open Data Catalog); the item's use constraints disclaim liability (NOT FOR ENGINEERING PURPOSES).
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the publisher; CC BY 3.0 does not restrict it
sources.redistribution: Attribution required (CC BY 3.0). Attribution: City and County of Denver
sources.notes: ArcGIS Online item 169272beebc54212ac08f3f607bef272, 'Energize Denver 2025 Master Dataset' (2025_Master_Data_Set_090326.xlsx, 2,700 rows, modified 2026-09-22): the benchmarking results of buildings of 25,000 sq ft and more. The workbook names buildings (a name column) and gives a street address but no parcel number; the adapter reads no name and joins on the street address. The Hub (opendata-geospatial-denver.hub.arcgis.com) has Crawl-delay 60, so the ArcGIS Online item behind it is fetched; www.arcgis.com/robots.txt has no rules for this path.
